headline: The decision may be easier than maintaining it
body:
Monday and Tuesday bring enough impatience to move a conversation, application, purchase, or plan that has been sitting in discussion. Chiron stations retrograde in Taurus on Monday, and the decision may press on an older fear about money, stability, or whether you can afford to stop proving that you can manage without help.

By Wednesday, the Last Quarter Moon in Taurus makes the cost harder to ignore. The plan may be possible, but the schedule, budget, or division of labor does not work yet. If everyone agreed and one person is still expected to absorb the extra responsibility, the agreement is not finished.

Venus enters Libra on Thursday, followed by the Sun trine Saturn. A vague promise can become a fairer arrangement now. Name the deadline. Clarify who is paying. Divide the work before resentment becomes part of the plan. You do not need to abandon a good idea because the first version was unrealistic. You need a version people can actually maintain.
